subject: Materials Science
title: Piezoelectric Ceramics
description: A short lesson to help you apply Piezoelectric Ceramics.

hook.text: Squeeze a crystal and it generates electricity. Apply voltage and it vibrates. Same material.

buildup.text: Piezoelectric ceramics like PZT convert mechanical force to voltage and vice versa.

discovery.text: Ultrasound imaging sends sound waves into the body using piezoelectric pulses.

twist.text: The same effect makes quartz watches tick — a tiny crystal vibrates 32,768 times per second.

climax.text: Fuel injectors, sonar, and phone speakers all depend on piezoelectric ceramics.

punchline.text: Squeeze this ceramic and it talks in electricity.

quiz.question: What is the piezoelectric effect?
options: Converting between mechanical force and electrical voltage
